concept.name: Forward contract
concept.definition: A privately negotiated agreement obligating two parties to exchange a specified asset or cash amount on a future date at terms fixed today.
concept.intuition: It defines the legal and economic claim being traded, including who must perform and when.
concept.mechanics: Set notional, underlying, delivery date, price or rate, settlement method, collateral, and counterparty terms; value changes as market forward terms move.
concept.failure_modes: Counterparty, settlement, liquidity, exercise, basis, and leverage terms differ by venue and contract and can dominate the apparent payoff.
concept.misconceptions: Similar price exposure does not make spot, forwards, futures, and options operationally or legally interchangeable.
concept.example: A farmer agrees today to deliver 10,000 bushels in six months at $5 per bushel to a named buyer.
